delivery.title: Ttfaṣil n usiweḍ - {{id}}
delivery.passExplainer: "Aɛeddi" dagi anamek-is kan d akken aqeddac n yiswi yuɣal-d s tɣawla HTTP 2xx - ur yettqadar ara anagraw n usqerdec s tidet yettwaḥrez neɣ yesseqdec aselkim. Sefqed tafekka n tririt nnig-a ɣef wayen ay d-tenna s tidet; ma yella d aẓayan neɣ d asteɛref kan, anagraw-nni yezmer ad yili yettqabal asuter maca yettugi neɣ yettḥeqri aɛeqqa n lfayda s daxel (ismawen n yigensasen/aḍris ur nelli ara d ayen yelhan i API ines , aḥric yettwaḥettmen deg tama-ines ur t-id-yettaf ara uɛeqqa-agi n lfayda, atg.).

push.title: Webhooks n tuffɣa - Push Leads & Imuhal
push.intro: Yezmer ad yettwasbedd s lekmal-is i yal webhook : JSON , Tafelwit (x-www-tafelwit-urlencoded), neɣ aḍris-ik n tfekka n Uferdis s yiferdisen n umḍiq <fieldkey></fieldkey> (am <example></example> ) - ixeddem am uččar n umyager cURL yiwet n tikkelt.
push.curlLabel: Lqem cURL n CRM n umsaɣ-ik .
push.curlHelp: Ssneḍ amedya n usuter n yiḍrisen-nsen API neɣ Postman i k-d-yettak (s yisefka n tidet neɣ n lemtel). URL , tarrayt d yiqeddacen ttwasekkren akken llan, yerna yal tasarut deg tfekka tettwasemres ddaw akken ad tzemreḍ ad tefrenḍ anwa aḥric CRM ara t-yeččaren i yal aselway.

push.howFilled: Amek ara ttwaččaren wazalen : webhook a yettwaseqdec daɣen i yal aselway - Leadrat ur yettazen ara amedya n tmeẓdit, yettazen aḍebsi amaynut yal tikkelt ara d-teḍru tedyant yettwafernen, s wazalen n tura n uselway-NNI.

push.howFilledCustom: Custom - aru-d tafekka n usuter-ik s timmad-ik anda ma telliḍ; yal yiwen yettwabeddel s wazal n tidet n l’lead-nni qbel kan ad yettwazen. Kned ɣef yiwen n umgired ddaw akken ad t-tessekcemḍ.
